00256 inline int wrap(int in, int lo, int hi) throw()
00257 {
00258   int range;
00259   if (in >= hi) 
00260   {
00261     range = hi - lo;
00262     in -= range;
00263     if (in < hi) return in;
00264   } 
00265   else if (in < lo) 
00266   {
00267     range = hi - lo;
00268     in += range;
00269     if (in >= lo) return in;
00270   } 
00271   else return in;
00272   
00273   if (hi == lo) return lo;
00274   //return in - range * std::floor((in - lo)/range); 
00275   
00276   return in % range + lo;
00277 }

00548 inline float linlin(const float input, 
00549           const float inLow, const float inHigh,
00550           const float outLow, const float outHigh) throw()
00551 {

00553   float outRange = outHigh - outLow;
00554   return (input - inLow) * outRange / inRange + outLow;

00576 inline float linsin(const float input, 
00577           const float inLow, const float inHigh,
00578           const float outLow, const float outHigh) throw()
00579 {
00580   float inRange = inHigh - inLow;
00581   float outRange = outHigh - outLow;
00582     
00583   float inPhase = (input - inLow) * pi / inRange + pi;
00584 #ifndef UGEN_ANDROID
00585   float cosInPhase = (float)std::cos((double)inPhase) * 0.5f + 0.5f;
00586 #else
00587   float cosInPhase = cosf(inPhase) * 0.5f + 0.5f;
00588 #endif
00589   
00590   return cosInPhase * outRange + outLow;  
00591 }
00592

00603 #else

00625 inline float linexp(const float input, 
00626           const float inLow, const float inHigh,
00627           const float outLow, const float outHigh) throw()
00628 {
00629   float outRatio = outHigh / outLow;
00630   float reciprocalInRange = 1.f / (inHigh - inLow);
00631   float negInLowOverInRange = reciprocalInRange * -inLow;
00632   return outLow * pow(outRatio, input * reciprocalInRange + negInLowOverInRange); 
00633 }
00634

00641   double negInLowOverInRange = reciprocalInRange * -inLow;
00642   return outLow * pow(outRatio, input * reciprocalInRange + negInLowOverInRange); 
00643 }

00653 inline float linwelch(const float input, 
00654             const float inLow, const float inHigh,
00655             const float outLow, const float outHigh) throw()
00656 {
00657   float inRange = inHigh - inLow;
00658   float outRange = outHigh - outLow;
00659   float inPos = (input - inLow) / inRange;
00660 
00661 #ifndef UGEN_ANDROID
00662   if (outLow < outHigh)
00663     return outLow + outRange * std::sin(piOverTwo * inPos);
00664   else
00665     return outHigh - outRange * std::sin(piOverTwo - piOverTwo * inPos);
00666 #else
00667   if (outLow < outHigh)
00668     return outLow + outRange * sinf(piOverTwo * inPos);
00669   else
00670     return outHigh - outRange * sinf(piOverTwo - piOverTwo * inPos);  
00671 #endif
00672 }
